summary: Manual design assessment passed. The node now defines a parent-owned screen-content host that forwards activate/deactivate/resume/suspend/cleanup transitions to embedded live panes, keeps shared-bridge ownership at the parent screen, and requires lazy activation so hidden panes do not add startup pressure.
checks: Research explains why embedded live panes need tab-activation lifecycle separate from whole-screen resume semantics.
Decisions choose a parent-owned host/controller instead of a heavyweight screen base or pane-owned ambient lifecycle.
Acceptance criteria cover initial active-pane-only load, tab-switch deactivation ordering, and suspend/unmount cleanup without stealing shared-bridge ownership.
Implementation notes identify Exchange as the proving ground and connect pane-local resources back to WidgetResourceScope.
